name: Rossau Imbiss
kurzbeschreibung:
**Rossau Imbiss in Tirol**

Discover the heart of **Tirol** with a visit to **Rossau Imbiss**, a beloved local spot nestled in the vibrant city of **Innsbruck**. This cozy eatery is famous for its authentic Austrian flavors, serving up classic dishes that will make your taste buds dance.

Start your day with a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized shreds of pancake, dusted with powdered sugar and served with fresh fruit or a dollop of apricot jam. For lunch, sink your teeth into a juicy **Wiener Schnitzel**, crispy on the outside and tender within, paired with a side of **Erdäpfel** (potatoes) and a fresh **Salat**.

If you're craving something lighter, try their **Käseknödel**—soft, cheesy dumplings in a rich broth, or a warm **Gulasch**, slow-cooked to perfection. Wash it all down with a cold **Tiroler Bier** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle** (apple juice spritzer).

**Rossau Imbiss** is more than just a place to eat—it’s a taste of **Tirol**’s soul. Whether you're a local or a traveler, this spot promises a warm welcome and unforgettable flavors. Don’t miss out on the chance to experience the best of Austrian comfort food in the stunning backdrop of the **Alpen**.
